algorithms.text: 算法 4-1　已审核笔记的实体关系抽取与写入输入：已审核笔记 n、当前版本字段 F 和正文 C、关联附件 A、重建标志 rebuild；调用方已开启事务。输出：实体集合 E、关系集合 R、抽取运行记录 U。1:if rebuild then2:ClearNoteGraph(n.id)3:end if4:E ← ∅; R ← ∅; T ← ∅5:p ← UpsertEntity(project, n.project_id)6:e_n ← UpsertEntity(note, n.id); E ← {p, e_n}7:B ← BasicEdges(n, A, p, e_n)8:for (u, v, ρ) in B do9:E ← E ∪ {u, v}10:R ← R ∪ {UpsertRelation(u, v, ρ, 1.0)}11:end for12:for (k, v) in RecursiveFields(F, C) do13:if ClassifyKey(k) ≠ ∅ then14:T ← T ∪ SplitValue(v, ClassifyKey(k))15:end if16:end for17:x ← FlattenText(F, C)18:T ← T ∪ MatchMarkers(x) ∪ MatchDomainRules(x)19:T ← MergeByKey(T, type, Normalize(label))20:for t in T do21:e ← UpsertEntity(n.project_id, t.type, t.label)22:r ← UpsertRelation(e_n, e, t.relation, 0.7, t.roles)23:E ← E ∪ {e}; R ← R ∪ {r}24:end for25:U ← RecordRun(n, |E|, |R|, completed)26:return E, R, U
